items.name: A New Edifice
items.description:
You may not use technology specialties.
When you would gain a relic Instead purge it and explore up to 3 planets you control.

items.name: Abyssal Embrace
items.description: When you create the game board Place the Ghoti Space tile where your home system would normally be placed. The Ghoti Space system is not a home system.

items.name: Aetherpassage
items.description: After a player activates a system You may allow that player to move their ships through systems that contain your ships.

items.name: Allure of Darkness
items.description: At the start of the strategy phase: Choose 1 other player's commander that does not have the lich token on it and place the lich token on it.

items.name: Amalgamation
items.description: When you produce a unit You may return 1 captured unit of that type to produce that unit without spending resources.

items.name: Ambush
items.description: At the start of a space combat You may roll 1 die for each of up to 2 of your cruisers or destroyers in the system. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, produce 1 hit; your opponent must assign it to 1 of their ships.

items.name: Analytical
items.description: When you research a technology that is not a unit upgrade technology You may ignore 1 prerequisite.

items.name: Ancient Blueprints
items.description: The first time you gain a cultural, hazardous, industrial, or unknown relic fragment Place the corresponding "Fragment" token on your faction sheet. (Async handles this by showing the Blueprint in your player area)

items.name: Ancient Empire
items.description: During setup, place 1 tomb token on each of up to 14 planets. When you gain control of a planet that contains a tomb token, purge that token to capture 2 infantry from the supply.

items.name: Ancient Knowledge
items.description: When you use a technology specialty to ignore a prerequisite on a technology card you are researching You may ignore 1 additional prerequisite of the same color. After you exhaust a planet to use its technology specialty, you may gain 1 commodity.

items.name: Arbiters
items.description: When you are negotiating a transaction, action cards can be exchanged as part of that transaction.

items.name: Armada
items.description: The maximum number of non-fighter ships you can have in each system is equal to 2 more than the number of tokens in your fleet pool

items.name: Arms Dealers
items.description:
You cannot resolve the effects of Axis Order cards.
When a player negotiates a transaction They may exchange Axis Order cards in their play area as part of that transaction.

items.name: Assimilate
items.description: When you gain control of a planet Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.

items.name: Autonetic Memory
items.description: When you draw 1 or more action cards You may draw 1 less card to choose 1 card from the action card discard pile and add it to your hand, or to place 1 infantry on a planet you control.

items.name: Awaken
items.description: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your sleeper tokens You may replace each of those tokens with 1 PDS from your reinforcements.

items.name: Battle-Tested Designs
items.description:
When you research a unit upgrade technology: You may exhaust 1 planet you control to ignore 1 prerequisite of that technology.

Then, you may produce 1 unit of that type in a system that contains your units and no other player's ships, reducing its cost by 1.

items.name: Binding Debts
items.description:
Other players may place their control tokens on your faction sheet at any time.
At the start of the status phase Each of your neighbors may give you 1 trade good to remove up to 2 of their control tokens from your faction sheet.

items.name: Biophobic
items.description: During the agenda phase The number of votes you cast is instead equal to the number of planets you exhaust to cast votes.

items.name: Black Markets
items.description: When you explore a planet You may treat that planet as if it had the same trait as another planet you control.

items.name: Black Ops
items.description: After you win a combat as the attacker You may remove 3 of your opponent's control tokens from your faction sheet to gain 1 command token, draw 2 action cards, or draw 1 secret objective

items.name: Blood Ties
items.description: You do not have to spend influence to remove the custodians token from Mecatol Rex.

items.name: Borrowed Authority
items.description: ACTION: Return 1 player's command token from your tactic pool and perform a tactical action in a non-home, non-Mecatol Rex system with no other player's units, using a token from that player's reinforcements.

items.name: Brilliant
items.description: When you spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card You may resolve the primary ability instead.

items.name: Byssus
items.description: You may treat your mechs on planets you control as structures for any purpose other than scoring objectives.

items.name: Call of the Haunted
items.description: During setup: Select 1 Revenant leader set to play with. Purge the unchosen leaders. You have 1 additional leader of each type.

items.name: Capital Fleet
items.description: Destroyers count as 1/2 of a ship against your fleet pool.

items.name: Cargo Raiders
items.description: During the first round of a space combat You may prevent your opponent from declaring a retreat unless they spend 1 trade good.

items.name: Celestial Guides
items.description: Your units do not roll for gravity rifts. You may ignore the movement effects of anomalies in systems that contain or are adjacent to 1 or more of your structures.

items.name: Celestial Reclamation
items.description: Planets that contain Core tokens have a base resource value of 2 and influence value of 0. Core tokens cannot be removed from the planet that contains them.

items.name: Classified Developments
items.description: ACTION: Spend a combined total of 5 resources or influence to place 1 superweapon on a planet you control, and gain its superweapon card.

items.name: Cloaked Fleets
items.description: After you produce 1 or more ships You may place up to 2 of those ships on your faction sheet, those ships are captured.

items.name: Coalescence
items.description: If your flagship or your AWAKEN faction ability places your units into the same space area or onto the same planet as another player's units, your units must participate in combat during "Space Combat" or "Ground Combat" steps.

items.name: Collateralized Loans
items.description: After 1 of your opponent's ships is destroyed during a round of space combat: You may remove 1 of that player's control tokens from your faction sheet to place 1 ship of that type from your reinforcements in the active system.

items.name: Colony Outposts
items.description: At the end of a tactical action during which you explored a planet: You may spend 1 command token to reveal cards from that planet's exploration deck until you reveal an attachment. Resolve that exploration and shuffle the revealed cards back into the deck.

items.name: Combat Drones
items.description:
Your space docks cannot produce infantry.
At the start of invasion You may replace each of your fighters in the active system with 1 infantry unit. During invasion, your infantry in the space area of the active system do not count against your ships' capacity.

items.name: Commanding Presence
items.description: When you unlock or purge a leader for its effect: Gain 1 command token.

items.name: Conspirators
items.description: Once per agenda phase, after an agenda is revealed, if you are not the speaker You may choose to vote after the speaker on that agenda.

items.name: Contagion
items.description: After you resolve the primary or secondary ability of the "Politics" strategy card Commit 1 infantry from your reinforcements to a planet that is in or adjacent to a system that contains a planet you control; resolve invasion on that planet.

items.name: Corporate Entity
items.description: During setup, take the additional Veldyr faction promissory notes; you have 4 faction promissory notes. Branch Office attachments do not count toward scoring objectives.

items.name: Council Patronage
items.description: At the start of the strategy phase Replenish your commodities, then gain 1 trade good.

items.name: Crafty
items.description: You can have any number of action cards in your hand. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.

items.name: Creuss Gate
items.description: When you create the game board, place the Creuss Gate (tile 17) where your home system would normally be placed. The Creuss Gate system is not a home system. Then, place your home system (tile 51) in your play area.

items.name: Cunning
items.description: After you perform a tactical action in a system You may attach 1 "Trap" card from your reinforcements to a planet in that system that contains 1 or more of your infantry units.

items.name: Cybernetic Madness
items.description:
After you resolve an action card's ability text, purge that card instead of discarding it.
After you add 1 or more action cards from the discard pile to your hand Discard 1 action card.

items.name: Cycle of Reclamation
items.description:
During setup: Place the moon phase cards in your play area.

Once per action, except during your tactical actions and whenever you use a unit ability: if a unit is destroyed in a system containing or adjacent to a system containing 1 of your ships, you may capture 1 neutral destroyer.

items.name: Dark Purpose
items.description: When you score an objective Gain 1 command token.

items.name: Dark Whispers
items.description: [Franken only] During setup, take the Dark Pact promissory note as an additional component, and you may choose Blood Pact as an optional component in place of your drafted promissory notes; you have 2 faction promissory notes.
items.originalDescription: During setup, take the additional Empyrean faction promissory note; you have 2 faction promissory notes

items.name: Data Leak
items.description: When you would gain a relic You may draw 1 additional card; choose 1 to gain and return the rest to the relic deck. Then, shuffle the relic deck.

items.name: Data Recovery
items.description: Once per action, after 1 or more of your units is destroyed, you may place 1 of the active player's control tokens on your faction sheet.

items.name: Decree
items.description: You may prevent ships from moving through anomalies that contain your ground forces.

items.name: Deep Mining
items.description: When you would explore a planet that contains 1 of your mechs or structures You may instead gain 1 trade good.

items.name: Deliberate Action
items.description:
You cannot redistribute command tokens during the status phase.
When you pass You may place 1 command token from your reinforcements in 1 pool on your command sheet that contains no command tokens.

items.name: Desperados
items.description: When you produce one or more units One destroyer does not count against your PRODUCTION limit. Apply +1 to your destroyers' move values while you are not the active player.

items.name: Devotion
items.description: After each space combat round You may destroy 1 of your cruisers or destroyers in the active system to produce 1 hit and assign it to 1 of your opponent's ships in that system.

items.name: Devour
items.description: Capture your opponent's non-structure units that are destroyed during combat.

items.name: Diplomatic Immunity
items.description: You do not have to spend a command token to use the secondary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card. Other players cannot place your tokens for the primary effect of Diplomacy.

items.name: Diplomats
items.description: Once per action You may exhaust 1 uncontrolled planet's planet card that is on the game board to spend its resources or influence.

items.name: Distant Suns
items.description: When you explore a planet that contains 1 of your mechs You may draw 1 additional card; choose 1 to resolve and discard the rest.

items.name: Divination
items.description: Before you would roll a die You may instead return 1 Omen die near your faction sheet to your reinforcements to resolve that roll as if it had the result of that die.

items.name: Echo of the Anvil
items.description: When you produce 2 or more units: Reduce the combined cost by 1 if you produced at least 2 units of the same type.

items.name: Edict
items.description: When you win a combat, place 1 command token from your opponent's reinforcements in your fleet pool if it does not already contain 1 of that player's tokens; other players' tokens in your fleet pool increase your fleet limit but cannot be redistributed.
items.originalDescription:
Other player's tokens in your fleet pool increase your fleet limit but cannot be redistributed.
When you win a combat Place 1 command token from your opponent's reinforcements in your fleet pool if it does not already contain 1 of that player's tokens.

items.name: Edict Y
items.description: Each owner token on your Primacy ability increases your fleet limit by 1.

items.name: Evolved Warforms
items.description: Your mechs are treated as both ships and ground forces and gain Move 1. Mechs not being transported count against fleet capacity.

items.name: Expeditionary Cache
items.description: When you gain 1 or more commodities: You may spend any number of commodities to place expedition tokens on planets, up to the number of commodities spent.

items.name: Fabrication
items.description: ACTION Either purge 2 of your relic fragments of the same type to gain 1 relic; or purge 1 of your relic fragments to gain 1 command token.

items.name: Facsimile
items.description: At the start of a space combat while you are the defender You may spend influence equal to the cost value of 1 of your opponent's ships in the active system to place 1 unit of that type from your reinforcements in that system.

items.name: Factory Lease
items.description: During setup, gain the Factory Lease promissory notes. At the start of the agenda phase: You may produce 1 unit other than a war sun in a system containing 1 of your space docks and no other players' ships for each Factory Lease attachment on the game board.

items.name: Fine Print
items.description: After a player resolves the secondary ability of 1 of your strategy cards Place up to 1 of their control tokens on your faction sheet.

items.name: Flotilla
items.description: You cannot have more infantry than non-fighter ships in the space area of a system.

items.name: Forbidden Knowledge
items.description: The effects of Primordial technologies cannot be used by other players. Primordial technologies have no ability text unless the player using their effect has 4 other technologies of that color, ignoring synergies.

items.name: Foresight
items.description: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your ships You may place 1 token from your strategy pool in an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships; move your ships from the active system into that system.

items.name: Fortune Seekers
items.description: Once per action, after you explore a planet or frontier token You may gain 1 commodity.

items.name: Fragile
items.description: Apply -1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls.

items.name: Free People
items.description: During setup, for each non-home planet other than Mecatol Rex on the game board, place that planet's planet card face up on the game board.

items.name: Future Sight
items.description: During the Agenda phase, after an outcome that you voted for or predicted is resolved Gain 1 trade good

items.name: Galactic Threat
items.description:
You cannot vote on agendas
Once per agenda phase, after an agenda is revealed You may predict aloud the outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 technology that is owned by a player who voted how you predicted.

items.name: Galvanize
items.description:
Galvanized units roll 1 additional die for combat rolls and unit abilities.
When a game effect instructs a player to galvanize a unit they place a galvanize token beneath it if it does not have one.

items.name: Garden Worlds
items.description: Apply +1 to the resource values of planets you control that do not contain 1 or more ground forces.

items.name: Gashlai Physiology
items.description: Your ships can move through supernovas

items.name: Glory
items.description: After you win a combat You may place or move a Glory token into the active system, or spend 1 token from your strategy pool to research a unit upgrade technology of the same type as 1 of your units that participated in that combat.

items.name: Grace
items.description: Once per action phase, after you resolve the primary ability of a strategy card You may resolve the secondary ability of 1 unexhausted strategy card with a lower printed initiative number than that strategy card.

items.name: Guild Ships
items.description: You can negotiate transactions with players who are not your neighbor.

items.name: Harrow
items.description: At the end of each round of ground combat Your ships in the active system may use their BOMBARDMENT abilities against your opponent's ground forces on the planet.

items.name: Heroism
items.description:
Capture your infantry and fighters that are destroyed during combat.
When you pass For each Glory token on the game board, you may return 4 of your captured units to gain 1 command token.

items.name: Hired Guns
items.description: After system is activated Choose up to 3 of your ships. Those ships are also treated as the active players and participate in combat as their units. At the end of this tactical action, that player may replace each of those ships in the active system with their own of the same unit type. Then, remove the rest from the game board.

items.name: Hive Echo
items.description: When you would use SPACE CANNON, ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE, or BOMBARDMENT, except during SPACE CANNON DEFENSE, in a system containing your ships, a unit with that unit ability up to 2 systems away may use it as if it were in the active system.

items.name: Holding Company
items.description: At the start of the status phase, for each planet that has a Branch Office attachment You may gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.

items.name: Honor-Bound
items.description: When you gain honor, place or flip 1 code token on your faction sheet face up, if able. When you gain dishonor, instead place or flip 1 code token face down, if able.

items.name: Hubris
items.description: During setup, purge your "Alliance" promissory note. Other players cannot give you their 'Alliance" promissory note.

items.name: Iconoclasm
items.description: When researching a non-unit upgrade technology You may purge 1 of your relic fragments to ignore 1 prerequisite on the technology you are researching.

items.name: Ignorant Discoveries
items.description: At the end of the action phase: You may purge 1 technology and spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to research 2 technologies.

items.name: Illusory Presence
items.description: During the agenda phase, after another player casts votes You may exhaust up to 2 planets you control; that player casts an additional number of votes equal to 1 more than the combined influence values of those planets.

items.name: Imperia
items.description: [Franken only] When you win a combat, place 1 command token from your opponent's reinforcements in your fleet pool if it does not already contain 1 of that player's tokens; other players' tokens in your fleet pool do not increase your fleet limit and cannot be redistributed. While another player's command token is on your command sheet, you can use the ability of that player's commander, if it is unlocked.
items.originalDescription: While another player's command token is in your fleet pool, you can use the ability of that player's commander, if it is unlocked.

items.name: Imperia Y
items.description: While another player's owner token is on your Primacy ability, you can use the abilities of that player's commanders, if they are unlocked.

items.name: Incursion
items.description: When you activate a system that contains a breach, you may flip that breach; systems that contain active breaches are adjacent. at the end of the status phase, any player with ships in a system that contain an active breach may remove that breach.

items.name: Indoctrination
items.description: At the start of a ground combat You may spend 2 influence to replace 1 of your opponent's participating infantry with 1 infantry from your reinforcements.

items.name: Industrialists
items.description: During setup, place the Celdauri space dock token in your reinforcements, the Celdauri space dock token is a fourth space dock unit.

items.name: Industrious
items.description: After you place a space dock on a planet in a system that contains no other players' ships You may spend 6 resources and remove that space dock to place 1 war sun in that system's space area.

items.name: Information Brokers
items.description: You may have 1 additional unscored secret objective.

items.name: Last Stand
items.description:
When your last unit would be destroyed during the Assign Hits step of combat: You may roll that unit's combat dice. For each result equal to or greater than that unit's combat value, produce 1 hit.

If all of your opponent's remaining participating units are destroyed by this roll, your unit is not destroyed.

items.name: Law's Order
items.description: At the start of any player's turn You may spend 1 trade good or 1 commodity to treat all laws as blank until the end of that turn.

items.name: Liberate
items.description: When you gain control of a planet ready that planet if it contains a number of your infantry equal to or greater than that planet's resource value; otherwise, place 1 infantry on that planet.

items.name: Limited Vision
items.description: You may not place a Stage II objective card on your faction sheet until all Stage I objectives have been revealed.

items.name: Lithoids
items.description: During the agenda phase The number of votes you cast is instead equal to the combined resource value of the planets that you exhaust.

items.name: Living Metals
items.description: Agenda outcomes and action cards that have component actions cannot remove or destroy your units, or place other player's units on planets you control.

items.name: Lobbyist Dues
items.description: During the agenda phase, if an outcome that you voted for or predicted is not resolved: Gain commodities equal to the number of players who voted for the outcome that was resolved.

items.name: Mandate of Presence
items.description: When you pass: You may spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to perform the primary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card.

items.name: Mantle Cracking
items.description: ACTION Place 1 "Core" token on a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not already contain a Core token to gain up to 4 trade goods.

items.name: Mark Of Pharadn
items.description: Abilities that would allow you to place infantry on the game board instead allow you to produce those units. When you produce infantry, you must return 1 of your captured infantry to produce each of those units, instead of spending resources.

items.name: Masters of Trade
items.description: You do not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Trade" strategy card.

items.name: Meditation
items.description: ACTION Spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to ready 1 of your technologies.

items.name: Mercenaries
items.description: At the start of a space combat You may remove up to 2 fighters you control in a system adjacent to the active system. Then, choose 1 player participating in that combat; that player places the same number of fighters from their reinforcements in the active system.

items.name: Meteor Slings
items.description: When your units use Bombardment against a planet another player controls You may cancel any number of hits you produce to place that many infantry from your reinforcements onto that planet. Those units participate in ground combat, if able

items.name: Migrant Fleet
items.description: After you explore a frontier token in a system You may explore a planet you control that is adjacent to that system.

items.name: Military Industrial Complex
items.description:
You may not give your commodities to other players as part of a transaction.
After you gain 1 or more commodities You may spend a number of commodities equal to the combined cost listed on any number of Axis Order cards in your reinforcements to place those cards in your play area.

items.name: Miniaturization
items.description:
Your structures can be transported by any ship; this does not require or count against capacity. While your structures are in the space area, they cannot use their unit abilities.
At the end of your tactical actions you may place your structures that are in space areas onto planets you control in their respective systems.

items.name: Mitosis
items.description:
Your space docks cannot produce infantry
At the start of the status phase Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control.

items.name: Mobile Command
items.description: The system that contains your flagship is your home system. Your flagship cannot be captured and you cannot score public objectives if your flagship is not on the game board.

items.name: Moult
items.description: After you win a space combat as the defender You may produce 1 ship in the active system, reducing the cost by 1 for each of your non-fighter ships destroyed during that combat.

items.name: Munitions Reserves
items.description: At the start of each round of space combat You may spend 2 trade goods to re-roll any number of your dice during that combat round.

items.name: Narrow Way
items.description: At any time At any time, you may spend 1 path token to redistribute 1 of your command tokens and move 2 of your infantry on the game board onto a planet you control.

items.name: Necrophage
items.description:
Apply +1 to your commodity value for each space dock you control.
After the first round of combat Gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.

items.name: Nomadic
items.description: You can score objectives even if you do not control the planets in your home system.

items.name: Obsessive Designs
items.description: During the action phase, after you research a unit upgrade technology You may use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks in your home system to produce units of that type, reducing the combined cost of the produced units by 2.

items.name: Oceanbound
items.description:
Any time you have more ocean cards than there are planets that contain your coexisting units, discard ocean cards until you do not.
When your units begin coexisting on a planet gain an ocean card and ready it.

items.name: Oracle AI
items.description: After the speaker reveals an unrevealed public objective Choose and look at 1 unrevealed public objective card; place that objective card on your faction sheet. You may look at the card on your faction sheet at any time.

items.name: Orbital Drop
items.description: ACTION Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.

items.name: Orbital Foundries
items.description: For the purpose of scoring objectives, you may treat each of your war sun units as though it is a structure on any planet you control.

items.name: Paranoia
items.description: Game effects other than your command tokens cannot prevent you from activating, or moving ships into, your home system.

items.name: Peace Accords
items.description: After you resolve the primary or secondary ability of the "Diplomacy" strategy card You may gain control of 1 planet other than Mecatol Rex that does not contain any units and is in a system that is adjacent to a planet you control.

items.name: Phoenix Standard
items.description: At the end of combat you may galvanize 1 of your units that participated.

items.name: Pillage
items.description: After 1 of your neighbors gains trade goods or resolves a transaction If they have 3 or more trade goods, you may take 1 of their trade goods or commodities.

items.name: Plague Reservoir
items.description: Once per action, during invasion on a planet that contains your units, you may resolve ground combat on that planet, even if it does not contain another player's ground forces.

items.name: Plausible Deniability
items.description: When you draw 1 or more secret objective cards Draw 1 additional secret objective card. Then, return 1 secret objective card to the secret objective deck; shuffle that deck.

items.name: Plots Within Plots
items.description:
You can score secret objectives already scored by other players if you fulfill their requirements; this does not count against your secret objective limit or the number you can score in a round.
When you score another player's secret objective do not gain a victory point; instead, place a facedown plot card into your play area with that player's control token on it.

items.name: Policies
items.description: When you gather your starting components, place the 3 "Policy" cards near your faction sheet, choose which side of each card to place face up.

items.name: Prescience
items.description: At the end of your turn,if you have not passed, place 1 of the plan cards on your faction sheet, face down. At the start of your turn, reveal and resolve the plan card on your faction sheet, if able

items.name: Prescient Memories
items.description:
You have 4 "Omen" Dice.
At the start of the strategy phase Take and roll each of the 4 "Omen" dice, place these dice near your faction sheet.

items.name: Pride
items.description: When you win a combat as the attacker, gain 1 honor if your opponent has more victory points than you, or gain 1 dishonor if they have fewer victory points than you; otherwise, gain 1 honor or 1 dishonor and ignore this ability until the end of your turn.

items.name: Primacy
items.description: When you win a combat Place 1 owner token from your opponent on this ability if it does not already contain 1 of that player's tokens.

items.name: Primordial Secrets
items.description: During setup: Select 1 primordial technology to play with. You have 1 additional faction technology.

items.name: Private Fleet
items.description: During setup, place 4 additional destroyers in your reinforcements

items.name: Privileged Citizenry
items.description: Each system can contain a number of your PDS equal to the number of command tokens in your fleet pool. For the purpose of scoring objectives, you may treat each of your PDS units as though it is a structure on any planet you control.

items.name: Probability Algorithms
items.description: When the speaker would reveal the next public objective They instead reveal the objective card on your faction sheet and place that objective card near the public objectives as the next public objective.

items.name: Projection of Power
items.description: At the start of a space combat in a system that is adjacent to or contains 1 or more of your space docks Choose up to 1 ship in that system to gain ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 6 until the end of that combat.

items.name: Propagation
items.description:
You cannot research technology
When you would research a technology Gain 3 command tokens instead.

items.name: Puppets of the Blade
items.description: If you have at least 1 plot card in your play area, gain the following ability: ACTION: Purge The Firmament's faction sheet, leaders, planet cards, and promissory note. Then, gain all of the faction components for The Obsidian.

items.name: Quantum Entanglement
items.description: You treat all systems that contain either an alpha or beta wormhole as adjacent to each other. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.

items.name: Quash
items.description: When an agenda is revealed You may spend 1 token from your strategy pool to discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.

items.name: Radiance
items.description: After an agenda is revealed You may predict aloud the outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 command token from another player's reinforcements in a Sigil.

items.name: Raid Formation
items.description: When 1 or more of your units uses ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE for each hit produced in excess of your opponent's fighters, choose 1 of your opponent's ships that has SUSTAIN DAMAGE to become damaged.

items.name: Rally to the Cause
items.description: Once per action, after you produce 1 or more ships in your home system You may produce up to 2 ships in a system that contains a cultural, hazardous, or industrial planet and does not contain a legendary planet or another player's units.

items.name: Rallying Cry
items.description: Systems that contain exactly 1 of your non-fighter ships gain PRODUCTION 2 as if they were units.

items.name: Raze
items.description: After 1 or more of another player's structures are destroyed on a planet that contains your units You may replenish your commodities.

items.name: Reclamation
items.description: After you resolve a tactical action during which you gained control of Mecatol Rex You may place 1 PDS and 1 space dock from your reinforcements on Mecatol Rex.

items.name: Recycled Materials
items.description: After you activate a system You may return 1 cruiser, carrier, or dreadnought you control in that system to your reinforcements to gain a number of trade goods equal to 1 less than that unit's cost value.

items.name: Reflections of the Void
items.description:
When you move units into a system with no planets, you may place 1 reflection token in a system that contains 1 or more planets you control.

At the end of a tactical action in a system that contains 1 or more reflection tokens, you may purge 1 of those tokens to explore the frontier deck in that system.

items.name: Research Team
items.description: When ground forces are committed if your units on that planet are not already coexisting, you may choose for your units to coexist.

items.name: Riftmeld

items.name: Twilight Defense Systems
items.description: Planets that contain your space docks or mechs gain PLANETARY SHIELD and SPACE CANNON 6 as if they were units. These planets may use their SPACE CANNON against ships that are adjacent to them. Other players' effects cannot make your units lose PLANETARY SHIELD.

items.name: Psychospore
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to remove a command token from a system that contains 1 or more of your infantry and return it to your reinforcements. Then, place 1 infantry in that system.

items.name: Power Word: Wish
items.description: When you gain this breakthrough choose a side for it to start on. When you research a propulsion or warfare technology, flip this card over. When you activate a system, you may apply +1 to the move value of 1 of those units and +2 to the combat value of 2 units you control during that tactical action.

items.name: Subjugate
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and spend 3 influence. Return 1 other player's command token from the game board to its reinforcements, then perform a tactical action in a non-home system without spending a command token.

items.name: Wing Transfer
items.description: When you activate a system that contains only your units, you may place command tokens from your reinforcements into any systems adjacent to that system that contain only your units; at the end of this action, you may move ships among the active system and systems adjacent to it that contain your command tokens.

items.name: Panoply Animus
items.description: Your structures gain SUSTAIN DAMAGE and participate in ground combat as if they were ground forces with a combat value of 7

items.name: Cryptic Insights
items.description: When you explore a planet, you may discard that card to draw 1 action card instead.

items.name: Arms Brokerage
items.description: At the start of a player's turn, you may exhaust this card to allow that player to treat 1 of your unit upgrade technologies as their own until the end of that turn. After you replenish commodities, gain a number of trade goods equal to the number of unit upgrade technologies you own.

items.name: The Icon
items.description: When you produce ships, you may exhaust this card to place those ships in a system that contains 1 of your command tokens, at least 1 of your ground forces, and no other player's ships.

items.name: Trinity Stockpile
items.description: At any time, you may exhaust this card and purge 1 command token from your strategy pool; destroy all units on a planet that contains a superweapon or is adjacent to your home system. Then, exhaust that planet, if able.

items.name: Historian Conclave
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to allow all other players to explore 1 planet they control. Then, place up to 1 infantry from your reinforcements into coexistence on 1 of those planets. When you explore a planet, you may exhaust this card to instead explore the frontier deck in that system.

items.name: Al'Raith Ix Ianovar
items.description:
This breakthrough causes The Fracture to enter play without a roll, if it is not already in play. After this card enters play, move up to 2 ingress tokens into systems that contain gravity rifts.
Apply +1 to the MOVE value of each of your ships that start their movement in The Fracture.

items.name: Trade Protectorate
items.description: When you gain this card, flip this card and place it on your faction sheet. Then, place the Celagrom token in a system that contains your ships, if able. The Celagrom token is a second flagship with the attributes, abilities, and ability text on the Celagrom flagship card.

items.name: Matriphagy
items.description: At the end of your turn, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 of your non-fighter ships on the game board; replace that ship with 1 or more units from your reinforcements that have a total combined cost less than that ship's cost value.

items.name: Resonance Generator
items.description:
During your tactical actions, apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships that starts its movement in your home system or in a system that contains an active breach.
ACTION: Exhaust this card to flip any breach or to place an active breach in a non-home system that contains your units.

items.name: Synaptic Interference
items.description: After you win a combat, you may purge 1 of your promissory notes from your hand to move 1 other player's command token in the active system to an adjacent system, or gain 2 trade goods. ACTION: Exhaust this card to discard the top 3 cards of the action card deck.

items.name: Visionaria Select
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to allow each other player to spend 3 trade goods and give you 1 promissory note. Each player that does may research a non-faction, non-unit upgrade technology. You also gain each technology researched in this way.

items.name: Exodus Engineering
items.description: Once per space combat, after 1 of your opponent's non-fighter ships is destroyed, you may exhaust this card to place 1 frontier token in the active system, or produce 1 or 2 non-fighter ship in that system to ready this card. You can produce ships in systems that contain both your ships and another player's ships.

items.name: Celestial Ambassadors
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and show another player 1 of your unscored secret objectives; that player must show you 1 of their unscored secret objectives, at random, or allow you to place 1 ground force from your reinforcements into coexistence on a planet they control.

items.name: Void Tether
items.description: When you activate a system that contains or is adjacent to a unit or planet you control, you may place or move 1 of your Void Tether tokens onto a border that system shares with another system; other players do not treat those systems as adjacent to each other unless you allow it.

items.name: The Sowing
items.description:
When you gain this card and at the start of the status phase, you may place up to 3 of your trade goods on this card.
Flip this card if you become The Obsidian faction.

items.name: Reverie Implants
items.description: At the end of your turn, you may exhaust this card and choose 1 other player; you and that player each secretly spend 0, 1, or 2 trade goods. Then, reveal the spent trade goods; if you spent a different number of trade goods, you may take 1 promissory note from that player's hand, at random, or explore 1 planet you control.

items.name: Galactic Movement
items.description: After you spend a strategy token, you may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements into coexistence on any cultural, hazardous, or industrial planet that contains the active player's ground forces. Your infantry tokens on planets you control can be accompanied by your control tokens instead of plastic pieces.

items.name: Raiding Parties
items.description: During each round of combat, you may choose 1 of your participating units; roll that unit’s combat roll twice and resolve the result of your choice. When you announce a retreat, you may exhaust this card to immediately resolve that retreat.

items.name: Particle Synthesis
items.description:
Each wormhole in a system that contains your ships gains PRODUCTION 1 as if it were a unit you control.
Reduce the combined cost of units you produce in systems that contain wormholes by 1 for each wormhole in that system.

items.name: Cult of the All-Mother
items.description: When you pass, you may exhaust this card to move 1 ingress token into an empty system, or move 1 of your ships to an adjacent system that contains your ships. Your units may retreat to any empty system that does not contain another player's ships.

items.name: Dhonraz Installations
items.description: Planets you control that contain core tokens are also treated as stations except for the purposes of control; units can be committed to, produced on, and placed on these planets. Stations you control have SPACE CANNON 5.

items.name: Auto-Factories
items.description: When you produce 3 or more non-fighter ships, place 1 command token from your reinforcements into your fleet pool.

items.name: Specialist Compounds
items.description: When you research technology using the 'Technology' strategy card, you may exhaust a planet that has a technology specialty instead of spending resources; if you do, you must research a technology of that color.

items.name: Relic Trading Hub
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and purge 1 relic fragment. Explore 1 planet with the same trait as the purged relic fragment and gain 2 purged relic fragments of any other color, if able.

items.name: I.I.H.Q. Modernization
items.description:
When you gain this card, gain the Custodia Vigilia planet card and its legendary planet ability card.
You are neighbors with all players that have units or control planets in or adjacent to the Mecatol Rex system.

items.name: Mended Grove
items.description: Gain the Grove card. When you resolve METEOR SLINGS, if you cancel all hits produced, you may place your units into coexistence; you cannot commit those coexisting ground forces during this action.

items.name: Bannerhalls
items.description: For each Glory token on the game board, you control 1 Bannerhall card. Once per action, when a player wins a combat in a system that contains a Glory token, ready each Bannerhall card.

items.name: The Collector's Museum
items.description: When you explore a planet, you may exhaust this card to resolve a card from that exploration deck's discard pile instead; if you would discard that card, instead shuffle it into the corresponding exploration deck.

items.name: Synchronicity VI
items.description:
ACTION: Exhaust this card to either gain 1 command token, or research a technology of the same color as one of your exhausted technologies.
When you exhaust a technology, gain 1 commodity.

items.name: The Queens’ Wrath
items.description: If you have the Dreadnought II technology, flip this card and place it on top of Dreadnought II.

items.name: Prototype Innovators
items.description: During each round of combat, or when you would roll dice for a unit ability, you may treat up to 3 units you control for which you own the corresponding unit upgrade technology as if they were Galvanized.

items.name: Strain Dispersal
items.description: When researching a technology, you may discard an action card to ignore 1 of that technology's prerequisites. Once per action, when you win a combat, for each technology your opponent owns, if you do not own that technology, gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.

items.name: Fealty Uplink
items.description: When you gain control of a planet, place infantry from your reinforcements equal to that planet's influence value on that planet.

items.name: Erasure Corps
items.description: After another player purges 1 or more non-action card components, gain 1 command token or ready this card. During the action phase, you may exhaust this card to explore 1 planet you control.

items.name: Gravleash Maneuvers
items.description:
Before you roll dice during space combat, apply +X to the results of 1 of your ship's rolls, where X is the number of ship types you have in the combat.
During movement, your non-fighter ships' move values are equal to the highest move value amongst moving ships in the system they started in.

items.name: Professional Intrigue
items.description: After you perform a tactical action in a non-home system, you may move 1 of your infantry on the game board into coexistence on a planet in that system. When a player ends your units' coexistence on a planet, they must discard 1 action card, if able.

items.name: Vaults of the Heir
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and purge 1 of your technologies to gain 1 relic.

items.name: The Table's Grace
items.description:
If you have the Cruiser II unit upgrade technology, flip this card and place it on top of cruiser II.
Corsair [Cost 2, Combat 6, Move 3, Capacity 2] If the active system contains another player's non-fighter ships, this unit can move through systems that contain other players' ships.

items.name: Stabilization Arrays
items.description: If you have the Fighter II unit upgrade technology, flip this card and place it on top of Fighter II.

items.name: Mirage Craft
items.description: At the start of a space combat in which you are the defender, you may swap 1 of your ships in the active system with 1 of your ships in another system that contains 1 of your command tokens; the swapped ships cannot transport units.

items.name: Stellar Genesis
items.description:
When you gain this card, place the Avernus planet token into a non-home system that is adjacent to a planet you control; gain the Avernus planet card and ready it.
After you move one of your war suns out of or through Avernus's system and into a non-home system, you may move the Avernus token with it.

items.name: Dreamwalkers
items.description: Capture other player's infantry that are destroyed during combat on planets you control. After each round of ground combat on a planet you control, roll a die. On a result of 7 or greater, place up to 1 of your captured infantry onto that planet, as if it were your own.

items.name: Remote Workforce
items.description: After you use PRODUCTION on 1 or more units, you may exhaust this card to resolve the PRODUCTION abilities of each unit you control in another system. Increase the combined PRODUCTION of those units by 2 and reduce the combined cost of those units by 1.

items.name: Mindsieve
items.description: When you would resolve the secondary ability of another player's strategy card, you may give them a promissory note to resolve it without spending a command token.

items.name: Absolute Synergy
items.description:
When you have 4 mechs in the same system, you may return 3 of those mechs to your reinforcements to flip this card and place it on top of your mech card.
Eidolon Maximum: [Combat 4 (x4), Move 3, Sustain Damage] This unit is both a ship and ground force. It cannot be assigned hits from unit abilities. Repair it at the start of every combat round. Game effects cannot place or produce your mechs. When this unit is destroyed or removed, flip this card and return it to your play area.

items.name: Valefar Assimilator Z
items.description: When you would gain another player's technology using one of your faction abilities, you may instead place one of your "Z" assimilator tokens on that player's faction sheet. Your flagship gains the text abilities of that faction's flagship in addition to its own.

items.name: Anomaly Stabilization
items.description: The system that contains the Wound token is also an entropic scar. You may ignore the effects of entropic scars. You may treat entropic scars as ingress tokens.

items.name: Mercenary Captains
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to place 1 neutral cruiser and 2 neutral destroyers into a non-fracture system that contains no non-neutral ships. After another player wins a space combat in a system that contains your ships, gain 2 commodities or 1 command token.

items.name: Thunder's Paradox
items.description: At the start of any player's turn, you may exhaust 1 of your agents to ready any other agent.

items.name: Call of the Void
items.description:
When you gain this breakthrough, draw red-backed tiles equal to the number of players. Starting with you and proceeding clockwise, each player places 1 on the edge of the game board so that it is adjacent to at least 2 other tiles. Place a frontier token in each of those systems without planets.

When you explore the frontier deck, draw an additional card deck, choose 1 to resolve, and discard the rest.

items.name: Insurrectionist Networking
items.description: Once per action, after you resolve a policy ability, you may spend 1 trade good to move 1 of your infantry on the game board into coexistence on a planet in an adjacent system. When you pass, you may purge this card to resolve invasion on all planets that contain your coexisting infantry.

items.name: Hidden Vaults
items.description: When you explore a planet, you may produce 1 infantry on that planet. At any time, you may exhaust this card to destroy any number of your units on the game board.

items.name: Self-Destruct Button
items.description: At the start of a combat, you may exhaust this card and destroy 1 non-fighter ship you control in that system. Produce hits equal to that unit's cost.

items.name: Duranium Outfitting
items.description: At the start of ground combat, choose 1 of your plastic-piece infantry participating in that combat; that plastic-piece unit gains SUSTAIN DAMAGE until the end of that combat.

items.name: Data Skimmer
items.description:
During the action phase, if you have not passed, when other players would discard action cards, they are placed on this card instead.
When you pass, take 1 action card from this card and discard the rest.

items.name: Revenant Rising
items.description: When you gain this breakthrough and each time you score a secret objective, you may draw 1 random unused agent and attach it to this card. This card has the ability text of each agent attached to it. Once per game round, when you would exhaust this card, you may purge 1 agent attached to this card instead.

items.name: The Prodigy’s Triumph
items.description: If you have the Terrafactory II technology, flip this card and place it on top of Terrafactory II.

items.name: Deorbit Barrage
items.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and spend any amount of resources to choose a planet up to 2 systems away from an asteroid field that contains your ships; roll a number of dice equal to the amount spent and assign 1 hit to a ground force on that planet for each roll of 4 or greater.

items.name: N'orr Supremacy
items.description: After you win a combat, either gain 1 command token or research a unit upgrade technology.

items.name: Bellum Gloriosum
items.description: When you produce a ship that has capacity, you may also produce any combination of ground forces or fighters up to that ship's capacity; they do not count against your PRODUCTION limit.

items.name: Lost Throne
items.description: When you gain this breakthrough, place the Aurelion station token in a system that contains a planet you control. Then, flip this card.

items.name: Slumberstate Computing
items.description:
When COALESCENCE results in a ground combat, if you commit no other units, you may choose for your units to coexist instead. During the status phase, for each player you are coexisting with, you and that player each draw 1 additional action card. 
Other players may allow you to place a sleeper token on a planet they control.

items.name: Hidden Hardpoints
items.description: At the end of a round of ground combat, you may discard 1 secret objective to have all your participating units enter coexistence. When a player ends your units' coexistence on a planet, you may draw 1 secret objective.

items.name: Dyrun's War-Bell
items.description:
If you have more Dishonor than Honor, flip this card. During each round of combat, up to 1 hit you cancel is instead produced against your opponent’s units. 
If you have more Honor than Dishonor, flip this card. Once per round of combat, you may produce 1 hit against your units to produce 1 hit against your opponent’s units.

items.name: Prescient Warriors
items.description: If you have the Infantry II technology, flip this card and place it on top of Infantry II.

items.name: High Security Vault
items.description: Other players cannot take or force you to give them any of your trade goods, commodities, or relic fragments, unless you allow it. When another player returns 1 of your promissory notes, place 1 of their control tokens on your faction sheet.

items.name: Gravitic Disruption
items.description: After you move 1 or more ships into the active system, you may discard an action card to move 1 of those ships into an adjacent system that does not contain another player’s ships.

items.name: Aurora Research Base
items.description: Your home system is also a nebula. Hits produced by the ability rolls of your units in nebulae cannot be canceled. When you pass, explore the frontier deck in your home system.

items.name: Unyielding Accord
items.description: When one or more other players place a command token in a system that contains 1 or more planets you control, ready 1 planet in that system and explore it.

items.name: Filibustered Legislation
items.description: When an agenda is resolved, you may exhaust this card. That agenda is resolved with no effect. Each player may ready 1 planet they control. During the agenda phase in which this effect is used, vote on 1 additional agenda.

items.name: Imperator
items.description:
Apply +1 to the results of each of your unit's combat rolls for each "Support for the Throne" in your opponent's play area.
After you activate a system that contains a legendary planet, apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships during this tactical action.

items.name: Archon's Gift
items.description:
You can spend influence as if it were resources.
You can spend resources as if it were influence.

items.name: Royal Rail Gun
items.description: When you gain this breakthrough, add 4 PDS to your reinforcements. If you own a PDS unit upgrade technology, flip this card over and place it in your play area. Your PDS units gain the following ability text and adjust their printed values by the indicated amounts. If they do not have those values, they gain them.

items.name: Yin Ascendant
items.description: When you gain this card or score a public objective, gain the alliance ability of a random, unused faction.

items.name: Deepgloom Executable
items.description: You can allow other players to use your STALL TACTICS or SCHEMING faction abilities; when you do, you may resolve a transaction with that player. During the action phase, that transaction does not count against the once-per-player transaction limit for that turn.

items.name: Rhodun's Reliquary
items.description: After you gain control of a legendary or fracture planet, you may research 1 technology or remove 1 of your command tokens in that system and return it to your reinforcements.

items.name: Awakened Planetoids
items.description: Your planets in the active system participate in space combat if that system contains 1 or more of your ships, and ground combat on themselves if they contain 1 or more of your ground forces. Your planets cannot be assigned hits and have a combat value equal to 10 minus their resource value, minimum 1.

items.name: Vorun Kael
items.description:
Once per action, when you lose a combat: Gain 1 command token.
Unlock: Lose a combat.

items.name: Dirzuga Rophal
items.description:
After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your units that have PRODUCTION: You may produce 1 unit in that system.
Unlock: Have 12 ground forces on planets you control.

items.name: Orthis Lithon
items.description:
When you exhaust a technology: You may place 1 fighter in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
Unlock: Own 1 technology in 2 different colors.

items.name: High Marshal Serisi
items.description:
When you gain 1 or more command tokens: Gain 1 commodity for each command token gained.
Unlock: Have your command tokens in 4 different systems.

items.name: Trrakan Aun Zulok
items.description:
When 1 or more of your units make a roll for a unit ability: You may choose 1 of those units to roll 1 additional die.
Unlock: Have 6 units that have ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE, SPACE CANNON, or BOMBARDMENT on the game board.

items.name: Ordagka
items.description:
Once per agenda phase, after an agenda is revealed You may predict aloud an outcome of that agenda. If you do not vote on that agenda, and your prediction is correct, gain 1 command token.
Unlock: Cast more votes for an outcome than any other player.

items.name: Lachis
items.description:
Ongoing This card satisfies a yellow technology prerequisite.When you cast at least 1 vote, cast 1 additional vote for every 2 technologies you own.
Unlock: Win a combat in a system that contains a legendary planet or a planet that has a technology specialty.

items.name: Designer TckVsk
items.description:
After a player resolves an Axis Order card: You may spend 6 resources to gain the corresponding unit's unit upgrade technology.
Unlock: Have 4 Axis Order cards of different unit types in 1 or more players' play areas.

items.name: Nip and Tuck
items.description:
At any time Your action cards cannot be canceled by "Sabotage" action cards. The Nekro Virus cannot place assimilator tokens on your components.
Unlock: There are 3 galvanized units on the game board

items.name: Ciphus Gault
items.description:
When one of your units would make a combat roll: You may use that unit's ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE instead. You cannot use this ability during the first round of space combat.
Unlock: Have 1 superweapon in your play area.

items.name: C.M.O. Ranc
items.description:
Ongoing Your commodity value is increased by 1.
Unlock: Have 3 Fragment tokens on your faction sheet.

items.name: That Which Molds Flesh
items.description:
When you produce fighter or infantry units: Up to 2 of those units do not count against your PRODUCTION limit.
Unlock: Have units in 3 gravity rifts.

items.name: Henry Storcher
items.description:
After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your space docks, gain 1 commodity. 

Your ships may treat systems that contain 1 or more of your space docks as adjacent to each other.
Unlock: Have 1 space dock on the game board that is not in or adjacent to your home system.

items.name: Spc. Phquaiset
items.description:
While you are the defender: After another player produces 1 or more hits against your units during ground combat, you may spend 1 commodity or 1 trade good to cancel 1 of those hits.
Unlock: Have 4 structures on non-home planets.

items.name: Ahk Siever
items.description:
At the end of a combat between any players: Gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.
Unlock: Place a breach token in a system that contains another player's unit.

items.name: Koryl Ferax
items.description:
After you gain control of a planet during a tactical action: You may discard 1 action card to place or move 1 mech onto that planet.
Unlock: Have 10 or more infantry on the board.

items.name: Aello
items.description:
When another player spends resources to research a technology That player may reduce the cost by 1; if they do, gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.
Unlock: Have an ocean card in play.

items.name: Clona Bathru
items.description:
Ongoing This card satisfies a red technology prerequisite. At the start of a space combat in a system that contains 3 or more different types of your non-fighter ships, produce 1 hit against your opponent's ships.
Unlock: Research a ship unit upgrade technology.

items.name: Kadryn
items.description:
When any game effect would allow you to score a public objective You may instead draw 1 secret objective.
Unlock: Have 1 or more laws in play.

items.name: Xuange
items.description:
After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 of your command tokens: You may return that token to your reinforcements.
Unlock: Be neighbors with all other players.

items.name: Captain Aroz
items.description:
At any time You can treat planets in systems that contain your ships as if they were controlled by you for the purpose of scoring secret objectives.
Unlock: Have a plot card in play

items.name: Quaxdol Junitas
items.description:
After the second agenda is revealed during the agenda phase: You may ready 1 planet you control. Explore that planet, if able.
Unlock: Have the outcome you voted for or predicted on an agenda resolved.

items.name: President Cyhn
items.description:
After you gain control of a non-home planet during a tactical action: If you have 1 or more ships in the active system, you may produce 1 ship in that system.
Unlock: Each non-legendary planet on the game board is controlled.

items.name: Jarl Vel & Jarl Jotrun
items.description:
After you win a combat in a system that contains no planets or on a planet that contains a structure You may gain 1 trade good.
Unlock: Have 2 flagships on the game board.

items.name: Sai Seravus
items.description:
After your ships move: For each ship that has a capacity value and moved through 1 or more wormholes, you may place 1 fighter from your reinforcements with that ship if you have unused capacity in the active system.
Unlock: Have units in 3 systems that contain alpha or beta wormholes.

items.name: Ceie Doleegueaunm
items.description:
After you activate a system You may treat systems that contain no planets as adjacent to each other during this tactical action.
Unlock: Have units in 3 systems that do not contain planets.

items.name: Voldun
items.description:
When you use the PRODUCTION of 1 or more of your units You may increase the total PRODUCTION value of those units by 1 for each space dock you control.
Unlock: Control non-fighter ships with a total combined cost value of at least 10 in 1 system.

items.name: Gila the Silvertongue
items.description:
When you cast votes: You may spend any number of trade goods: cast 2 additional votes for each trade good spent.
Unlock: Have 10 trade goods.

items.name: Agnlan Oln
items.description:
After you roll dice for a unit ability: You may reroll any of those dice.
Unlock: Own 8 technologies.

items.name: Seral Venn
items.description:
At the start of the strategy phase: Choose 1 non-home, non-legendary planet. Explore that planet as if it had any planet trait.
Unlock: Have 2 cards from different exploration decks in your play area.

items.name: Suffi An
items.description:
After you perform a component action: You may perform an additional action.
Unlock: Spend 1 trade good after you play an action card that has a component action

items.name: Hkot Tokal
items.description:
At the start of invasion in a system that contains 1 or more planets: You may place 1 infantry unit from your reinforcements in the active system's space area if you have unused capacity in that system.
Unlock: Win a ground combat on a planet you do not control.

items.name: Sdallari Tvungovot
items.description:
When researching a unit upgrade technology Each of your unit upgrade technologies may satisfy 1 prerequisite it shares with the technology you are researching
Unlock: Have 2 Glory tokens on the game board.

items.name: Kado S'mah-Qar
items.description:
Ongoing This card satisfies a blue technology prerequisite. When you retreat, if the active system does not contain 1 of your command tokens, you do not place a command token in the system your ships retreated to.
Unlock: Have 4 relic fragments.

items.name: Issac of Sinci
items.description:
Ongoing Apply +1 to each of your unit's ability rolls.
Unlock: During the action phase, ready 1 of your technologies.

items.name: Queen Lorena
items.description:
During the first round of a combat: You may cancel 1 hit produced against your units.
Unlock: Destroy the last of a player's units in a system.

items.name: Seraxis Thule
items.description:
At any time: Apply +1 to the combat rolls and unit ability rolls of units for which you own the unit upgrade technology.
Unlock: Own 2 unit upgrade technologies.

items.name: Silas Deriga
items.description:
When you cast votes: When you cast votes: You may remove up to 4 of your infantry from the game board to cast 1 additional vote for each unit removed.
Unlock: Have 6 infantry and 6 fighters on the game board.

items.name: 2RAM
items.description:
At any time: Units that have PLANETARY SHIELD do not prevent you from using BOMBARDMENT.
Unlock: Have 4 dreadnoughts on the game board.

items.name: Master Halbert
items.description:
After you explore a planet: You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.
Unlock: 7 relic fragments have been purged.

items.name: Rear Admiral Farran
items.description:
After 1 of your units uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE: You may gain 1 trade good.
Unlock: Have 5 non-fighter ships in 1 system.

items.name: Dhume Tathu
items.description:
During a round of combat in which no more than 1 of your non-fighter ships or 1 of your infantry is participating: You may choose 1 of your units in that combat, that unit rolls 1 additional combat die.
Unlock: Have 3 trap attachments on the game board.

items.name: Il Na Viroset
items.description:
During your tactical actions: you can activate systems that contain your command tokens. If you do, return both command tokens to your reinforcements and end your turn.
Unlock: Have 2 other factions' command tokens in your fleet pool.

items.name: Il Na Viroset Y
items.description:
During your tactical actions: You can activate systems that contain your command tokens. If you do, return both command tokens to your reinforcements and end your turn.
Unlock: Have an owner token from 3 other players on your Primacy ability.

items.name: S'ula Mentarion
items.description:
After you win a space combat: You may force your opponent to give you 1 promissory note from their hand.
Unlock: Have 4 cruisers on the game board.

items.name: Assault Machina
items.description:
During movement For each infantry you transport, you may replace that unit with 1 fighter.

You may use the SPACE CANNON of 1 of your units against ships that are adjacent to that unit's system.
Unlock: Own 2 unit upgrade technologies.

items.name: Komat
items.description:
At the start of a space combat while you are not the active player: Choose 1 of your non-fighter ships in the active system to gain SUSTAIN DAMAGE until the end of combat.
Unlock: Have ships in 3 systems not adjacent to or including your home system

items.name: Magmus
items.description:
After you spend a token from your strategy pool: You may gain 1 trade good.
Unlock: Produce a war sun.

items.name: Amanita Muscaria
items.description:
After another player produces 1 or more hits against your units during space combat: You may spend 1 commodity or 1 trade good to cancel 1 of those hits.
Unlock: Have 4 commodities on your faction sheet.

items.name: Thessa Scale
items.description:
Twice per round, when you place a structure from your reinforcements on a planet you control: Draw 2 action cards, then discard 1.
Unlock: Have 4 or more non-fighter ships of the same type in the same system.

items.name: M'aban
items.description:
At any time: You may look at your neighbors' hands of promissory notes and the top and bottom card of the agenda deck.
Unlock: Have ground forces in or adjacent to the Mecatol Rex system.

items.name: Dart and Tai
items.description:
After you gain control of a planet that was controlled by another player: You may explore that planet.
Unlock: Have mechs in 3 systems.

items.name: Nekro Acidos
items.description:
After you gain a technology: You may draw 1 action card.
Unlock: Own 3 technologies. A "Valefar Assimilator" technology counts only if its X or Y token is on a technology.

items.name: Thussad Krath
items.description:
During combat: When 1 or more of your damaged units make a combat roll, up to 2 of those units may roll an additional combat die.
Unlock: Have units in 2 different non-home anomalies.

items.name: Jack Hallard
items.description:
Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat: If you announced a retreat, cancel up to 2 hits. During combat, you may treat the active system as adjacent to each system adjacent to your home system.
Unlock: Another player moves 1 of your ships.

items.name: Navarch Feng
items.description:
When you produce: You can produce your flagship without spending resources.
Unlock: Have 1 scored secret objective.

items.name: Deyra the Voidborn
items.description:
When you purge 1 or more components: You may produce 1 unit with a cost of 4 or less in a system that contains 1 of your ships. Reduce its cost by 1.
Unlock: Have units in 3 systems adjacent to a system that contains no planets.

items.name: Knak Halfear
items.description:
When you pass: You may exhaust 1 non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex to gain a number of trade goods equal to that planet's resource or influence value.
Unlock: Control 1 cultural planet, 1 hazardous planet, and 1 industrial planet.

items.name: Avhkan
items.description:
At the start of ground combat on a planet you control You may destroy 1 infantry on that planet
Unlock: ACTION: Destroy 2 of your infantry on each of 5 planets.

items.name: Marshal Faelorn
items.description:
When you roll 1 or more dice: You may apply +2 to up to 2 of those dice.
Unlock: Have a damaged unit on the game board.

items.name: Ghaist Asmora
items.description:
After you perform an action: If you won a combat during that action, you may perform an additional action. 
Unlock: Win 2 combats in 1 turn

items.name: Watchful Ojz
items.description:
When you declare a retreat Immediately retreat up to 2 of your ships from the active system to an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. Place a command token from your reinforcements into that system.
Unlock: Be the last person to pass during the Action Phase

items.name: Ashara of the Silent Choir
items.description:
At any time: While the Lich Token is on an unlocked commander you may use the effect of that commander.
Unlock: 2 other players have unlocked commanders

items.name: B-Unit 205643a
items.description:
When you spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the “Construction” strategy card You may resolve the primary ability instead.
Unlock: Have units with a combined PRODUCTION value of at least 7 in a single system.

items.name: Rowl Sarring
items.description:
When you produce fighters or infantry: You may place each of those units at any of your space docks that are not blockaded.
Unlock: Have 3 space docks on the game board.

items.name: G'hom Sek'kus
items.description:
During the "Commit Ground Forces" step: You can commit (move) up to 1 ground force from each planet in the active system and each planet in adjacent systems that do not contain 1 of your command tokens.
Unlock: Control 5 planets in non-home systems.

items.name: Claire Gibson
items.description:
At the start of a ground combat on a planet you control: You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.
Unlock: Control planets that have a combined total of at least 12 resources.

items.name: Veythros the Shattered
items.description:
At any time: You may ignore the effects of each anomaly.
Unlock: Have units in 3 systems that contain or are adjacent to anomalies.

items.name: Tungstantus
items.description:
When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION: You may gain 1 trade good.
Unlock: Have 5 structures on the game board.

items.name: Fillipo Rois
items.description:
After you activate a system: You may produce and assign 1 hit to a non-fighter ship you control in a system to apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships in that system until the end of this tactical action.
Unlock: Have 6 of your destroyers on the game board.

items.name: Baird Feraux
items.description:
During each round of combat: One of your units may reroll 1 of its combat dice; if your opponent controls more units participating in that combat than you, one of your units may roll 1 additional combat die instead.
Unlock: Have a Code card

items.name: Reides Lupaat
items.description:
Once during each of your turns You may look at the top card of 1 non-objective common deck; you may spend 1 trade good or 1 commodity to place that card on the bottom of that deck.
Unlock: Lose control of a planet.

items.name: Komdar Borodin
items.description:
At the start of the status phase: Gain 1 trade good for each secret objective you have scored and 1 commodity for each public objective you have scored.
Unlock: Have 1 or more different players' control tokens on your faction sheet for every 2 players in this game.

items.name: Pyndil Gonsuul
items.description:
After you activate a system: Choose 1 ship you control with a capacity value, apply +2 to that value during this tactical action.
Unlock: Control 3 planets that each have the same trait.

items.name: Vera Khage
items.description:
When you research a technology that is owned by a player who controls a planet with a Branch Office attachment: You may ignore 1 prerequisite on that technology.
Unlock: 2 other players control 1 or more planets that have Branch Office attachments.

items.name: Velorine Nevorith
items.description:
At any time: Increase the influence and resource values of planets in systems that contain other players' command tokens by 1.
Unlock: Have units in a system that contains 2 or more other players' command tokens.

items.name: Cyrala Vey
items.description:
After an agenda is resolved: If an outcome you voted for is not resolved, produce 1 unit in a system that contains 1 of your ships with a cost up to the number of votes you cast.
Unlock: At the start of the agenda phase, exhaust all but 3 planets you control.

items.name: Rickar Rickani
items.description:
During combat: Apply +2 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls in the Mecatol Rex system, your home system, and each system that contains a legendary planet.
Unlock: Control Mecatol Rex or enter into a combat in the Mecatol Rex system.

items.name: Elder Qanoj
items.description:
When you vote: Each planet you exhaust to cast votes provides 1 additional vote. Game effects cannot prevent you from voting on an agenda.
Unlock: Control planets that have a combined total of at least 12 influence.

items.name: Zythrix
items.description:
When you produce 1 or more hits with a unit ability: Produce an additional hit.
Unlock: Produce 3 or more hits with a unit ability.

items.name: Brother Omar
items.description:
At any time: This card satisfies a green technology prerequisite. When you research a tech owned by another player, you may return 1 of your infantry to reinforcements to ignore its prerequisites.
Unlock: Use one of your faction abilities.

items.name: So Ata
items.description:
After another player activates a system that contains your units: You may look at that player's action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives.
Unlock: Have 7 action cards.

items.name: Bishop Ulin
items.description:
When researching a technology: You may use the technology specialty of 1 planet you control to ignore any 1 prerequisite on the technology card you are researching.
Unlock: Have a technology with 2 or more prerequisites.

items.name: Zelian B
items.description:
Ongoing Each of your Dreadnoughts and War Suns without ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE gains ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 5.
Unlock: Have 1 or more ships in 2 systems that contain an asteroid field.
