items.name: Kyro Rider
items.description:
After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on a planet you control.
Then, return this card to the Kyro player.

items.name: Spoils of War
items.description:
After you win a combat: Place this card face-up in your play area to explore 1 planet you control.
At the start of the Lanefir player's turn, return this card to the Lanefir player.

items.name: Trusted Counselor
items.description:
At the start of a space combat you are participating in: You may place up to 2 fighters from your reinforcements into the space area of the active system.
Then, return this card to the Li-Zho player.

items.name: Rapid Excavation
items.description:
At the start of your turn: You may move up to 2 PDS units you control to a planet you control.
Then, return this card to the Mirveda player.

items.name: Secrets of the Weave
items.description:
At the start of a space combat while you are the defender: You may spend influence equal to the cost value of 1 of your opponent's ships in the active system to place 1 unit of that type from your reinforcements in that system.
Then, return this card to the Mortheus player.

items.name: Gift of Insight
items.description:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area.While this card is in your play area, once per turn, after you roll a die, you may reroll that die.
If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Myko-Mentori player's units, return this card to the Myko-Mentori player.

items.name: Nivyn Guidance
items.description:
After you activate a system: During this activation, you may ignore the effects of each anomaly.
Return this card to the Nivyn player at the end of this activation.

items.name: Nokar Navigator
items.description:
At the start of a space combat: During this combat, the active system is adjacent to each system that contains a planet you control for the purposes of announcing and resolving retreats.
At the end of this combat, return this card to the Nokar player.

items.name: Incite Revolution
items.description:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area to choose and exhaust 1 planet you control. Then, ready 1 non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex.
At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Olradin player.

items.name: Death Binding
items.description: When the Pharad'n player passes, remove 4 of your infantry from the game board to gain 1 technology with no prerequisites. Then, return this card to the Pharad'n player; that player captures 1 infantry from the supply.

items.name: Alloy Shipments
items.description: At the start of a round of combat: Choose up to 3 of your units; during this round of combat, hits those units produce cannot be canceled. After this round of combat, return this card to the Qhet player.

items.name: Favor of Rhodun
items.description:
When you ignore a prerequisite on a technology card you are researching: You may ignore 1 additional prerequisite of the same color.
Then, return this card to the Rhodun player.

items.name: Automatons
items.description:
At the end of your turn, you may attach this card to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex.
This planet has PRODUCTION 3 as if it were a unit.

items.name: Plots Within Plots
items.description:
When you draw 1 or more secret objective cards: Draw 1 additional secret objective card. Then, return 1 secret objective card to the secret objective deck. Shuffle that deck.
Then, return this card to the Tnelis player.

items.name: Concordat Allegiant
items.description: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area. Once per action, when you win a combat against a player with more victory points than you, gain 3 commodities. You must spend 1 token from your fleet pool and return this card to the Toldar player to activate a system that contains that player's units.

items.name: Eerie Predictions
items.description:
At the start of the status phase: You may look at the top card of any 1 deck; place that card on the top or bottom of that deck. 
Then, return this card to the Uydai player.

items.name: Vaden Handshake
items.description:
After you activate a system: You may spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, apply +1 to the move value of 1 non-fighter ship you control during this activation.
Return this card to the Vaden player at the end of this activation.

items.name: Clan's Favor
items.description:
At the start of a round of space combat: The Vaylerian player discards 1 action card. Then, move all of your ships from the active system to an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw.
Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system and return this card to the Vaylerian player.

items.name: Branch Office - Tax Haven
items.description:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its influence value is increased by 1.

items.name: Branch Office - Broadcast Hub
items.description:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its influence value is increased by 1.

items.name: Branch Office - Reserve Bank
items.description:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its resource value is increased by 1.

items.name: Branch Office - Orbital Shipyard
items.description:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its resource value is increased by 1.

items.name: Hyperkinetic Ordinance
items.description:
When 1 or more of your units would make a BOMBARDMENT roll: If you produce 1 or more hits during this BOMBARDMENT roll, produce 1 additional hit for that roll.
Then, return this card to the Zelian player.

items.name: Political Favor
items.description: When an agenda is revealed: Remove 1 token from the Xxcha player's strategy pool and return it to their reinforcements. Then, discard the revealed agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead. Then, return this card to the Xxcha player.

items.name: Fires of the Gashlai
items.description: ACTION: Remove 1 token from the Muaat player's fleet pool and return it to their reinforcements. Then, gain your war sun unit upgrade technology card.  Then, return this card to the Muaat Player.

items.name: Gift of Prescience
items.description: At the end of the Strategy Phase: Place this card faceup in your play area and place the Naalu '0' token on your strategy card, you are the first in initiative order. The Naalu player cannot use their Telepathic faction ability during this game round. Return this card to the Naalu player at the end of the status phase.

items.name: Greyfire Mutagen
items.description: At the start of a ground combat against 2 or more ground forces that are not controlled by the Yin player: Replace 1 of your opponent's infantry with 1 infantry from your reinforcements. Then, return this card to the Yin player.

items.name: Creuss Iff
items.description: At the start of your turn during the action phase: Place or move a Creuss wormhole token into either a system that contains a planet you control or a non-home system that does not contain another player's ships. Then, return this card to the Creuss player.

items.name: Military Support
items.description: At the start of the Sol player's turn: Remove 1 token from the Sol player's strategy pool, if able, and return it to their reinforcements. Then, you may place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control. Then, return this card to the Sol player.

items.name: Nano-Link Permit
items.description: After you activate a system: You may move your structures from adjacent systems that do not contain your command tokens onto planets you control in the active system. Then, return this card to the Ral Nel player.

items.name: Promise of Protection
items.description: ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area. While this card is in your play area, the Mentak player cannot use their Pillage faction ability against you. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Mentak player's units, return this card to the Mentak player.

items.name: Research Agreement
items.description: After the Jol-Nar player researches a technology that is not a faction technology: Gain that technology. Then, return this card to the Jol-Nar player.

items.name: Raghs Call
items.description: After you commit 1 or more units to land on a planet: Remove all of the Saar player's ground forces from that planet and place them on a planet controlled by the Saar player. Then, return this card to the Saar player.

items.name: Raise the Standard
items.description: At the end of a combat: Galvanize 1 of your units that participated. Then, return this card to the Last Bastion player.

items.name: Keleres Rider
items.description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 1 action card and gain 2 trade goods. Then, return this card to the Keleres player.

items.name: Scepter of Dominion
items.description: At the start of the strategy phase: Choose 1 non-home system that contains your units, each other player who has a token on the Mahact player's command sheet places a token from their reinforcements in that system. Then, return this card to the Mahact player.

items.name: Sever
items.description: ACTION: place this card face up in your play area, and place the sever token in a system that contains your units, wormholes in that system have no effect during movement. Remove the sever token and return this card to the Rebellion player at end of the status phase.

items.name: Share Knowledge
items.description: ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area and gain 1 non-faction, non-unit upgrade technology that the Deepwrought player owns; place that technology on this card. Return that technology to the deck and this card to the Deepwrought player at the end of the status phase.

items.name: Spy Net
items.description: At the start of your turn: Look at the Yssaril player's hand of action cards. Choose 1 of those cards and add it to your hand. Then, return this card to the Yssaril player.

items.name: Stymie
items.description: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your units: You may place 1 command token from that player's reinforcements in any non-home system. Then, return this card to the Arborec player.

items.name: Tekklar Legion
items.description: At the start of an invasion combat: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat. If your opponent is the N'orr player, apply -1 to the result of each of their unit's combat rolls during this combat. Then, return this card to the N'orr player.

items.name: Terraform
items.description: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex. Its resource and influence values are each increased by 1, and it is treated as having all 3 planet traits (cultural, hazardous, and industrial).

items.name: Funeral Services
items.description: At the start of a round of combat, place this card face up in your play area: Each time a fighter is destroyed during this combat roll a dice, for each result greater than 5 place that fighter on this card. At the start of your next turn place each fighter in systems that contain your ships. Then, return this card to the Aeterna player.

items.name: Scroll of Ascension
items.description: At the start of the strategy phase: Research 1 non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology the Arcanum player does not own. If you do, the Arcanum player may spend 1 command token from their strategy pool to gain that technology. Then, return this card to the Arcanum player.

items.name: The Usurper's Lease
items.description: When you would spend influence to gain 1 or more command tokens: Increase the amount of influence spent by the number of neighbors you have. Then, return this card to the Ardentia player.

items.name: Archaeological Outpost
items.description: ACTION: Attach this card to 1 non-home planet. When you activate this planet's system, explore it.

items.name: Evolutionary Edict
items.description: When you research a unit upgrade: Produce 1 of those units in your home system. Reduce its cost by the number of its prerequisites. Then, return this card to the Kryxos player.

items.name: Factory Lease: Cultural
items.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a cultural planet you control: That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its influence value.

items.name: Factory Lease: Hazardous
items.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a hazardous planet you control: That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its resource value.

items.name: Factory Lease: Industrial
items.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to an industrial planet you conrol: That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to the number of planets in that system.

items.name: Shard of Nothingness
items.description: ACTION: Draw 3 unused red-backed tiles. Choose 1 and place it adjacent to 2 systems. If it contains no planets, place a frontier token in that system. Then, purge this card and the unchosen tiles.

items.name: Thunderbird Prototype
items.description: At the start of space combat select 1 of your ground forces in that system: That unit participates in combat as if it were a ship and you may treat them as Galvanized until the end of the combat. Return this card to the Ponthous player at the end of that combat.

items.name: Revenant Alliance
items.description: When you receive this card and you are not the Revenant Glory player, place it face up in your play area: While this is in your play area, you can use the Revenant Glory player's Pantheon commander ability if it is unlocked. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Revenant player's units, return this card to the Revenant player.

items.name: Thronebound Covenant
items.description: ACTION: Place an unused throne planet into your home system and gain control of it. Then, purge this promissory note.

items.name: Pact Renewed
items.description: When you perform the primary effect of a strategy card, you may place this card face up in your play area: Perform the secondary effect of that strategy card without spending a command token. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Verydith player.

items.name: Hand of the Synod
items.description: ACTION: Discard up to 1 action card and draw that many action cards + 1. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Veylor player.

items.name: Swarm Spawn
items.description: When you produce hits with a unit ability against your opponent's units, place this card face up in your play area. You may place fighters in a system contianing 1 of your ships equal to the number of hits produced. Then, return this card to the Xytheris player.

items.name: War Funding
items.description: After you and your opponent roll dice during space combat: You may reroll all of your opponent's dice. You may reroll any number of your dice. Then, return this card to the Letnev player.
